messages:
hyun: threw together a quick prototype for a 'deep shadow' variant of midnight. main ask: make the chart foregrounds pop without brightening the whole UI. thoughts?

mara: I like the depth. two quick concerns: (1) the area fills on stacked charts look muddy with the new panel gradient, (2) inline code in the timeline widget reads almost invisible on mobile in low-brightness settings.

otto: for stacked areas we could add subtle inner highlights (linear gradient to 90% opacity near top) to help separate layers. for mobile code, maybe increase bg contrast and bump padding so the rounded bg reads as a chip not a block.

hyun: implemented both in frame: /design/deep-shadow-v1 — area highlights are 6% lighter, code bg moved from #0b0c0e to #0f1113 and padding +2px. also tried a slightly warmer orange for the 3rd series to increase distinguishability.

theme-bot: uploaded tokens: primary-series `#5de8b7` @ 68%, tertiary `#ffb36b` @ 78%, panel-gradient top `#07080a` bottom `#0b0d0f`.

a11y-checker: contrast report:
- primary-series vs panel top: 6.3:1 ✅
- tertiary orange vs panel top: 3.9:1 ⚠️ (below 4.5 for small elements)
- code inline bg (#0f1113) vs panel bottom: 4.8:1 ✅
- stacked area separators (6% lighter) vs adjacent area: 1.9:1 ⚠️ (may be indistinct for colorblind users)
Recommendation: darken tertiary slightly and add 1px subtle stroke between stacked areas for better separation.

mara: darkening tertiary is fine. prefer stroke so we don't change perceived palette balance. can we try stroke using a 10% desaturated black overlay?

otto: will mock stroke and slightly darken orange to `#ff9a40` in tokens. also i'll increase the small legend swatch size from 8px to 10px for legibility.

hyun: tiny copy tweak: panel title currently "Token usage" -> suggest "Token usage — last 24h" for clarity on the dashboard since we have multi-range selectors.

mara: yes do that. also add a tooltip definition for "tail latency" term while you're at it.

a11y-checker: after changes re-run pending.

hyun: plan: otto to land token update + stroke mock, mara to update figma notes, i'll update console copy and test on staging flow. will re-run contrast audit after deploy. thanks! :raised_hands:

(attachments: figma_frame_deep_shadow_v1.png, token_diff.patch)
